title: Decision rights (T11)
intro: Who recommends, approves, is consulted and is informed for each decision, and its SLA.
listIntro: The first four rows come from the playbook (B0099). Editing them changes only this transformation, never the template or another transformation.

matrix.title: Business approval of the matrix
matrix.frozen: The matrix cannot change while it waits for approval.
matrix.submitNote: the matrix is decided by the mapped approver. Until then it is frozen.

edit.title: Edit the decision right
edit.description: Labels are kept as written. Party codes decide routing; the approver role must be mapped in Role mapping.
edit.partyListHint: Governance role codes separated by commas, for example SP, BO.
edit.approvePartyHint: Approvals of this decision go to whoever is mapped to this role.
edit.urgentHint: Optional. Without it, an urgent request is refused.
edit.escalationHint: Role codes in escalation order, for example BO, SP.

preview.title: Due date: {{decision}}
preview.intro: The due date a request raised on a given day would get. Unknown when it cannot be known (no calendar, no SteerCo scheduled, no release date).

request.description: The request is routed by the chosen decision right to the person or group mapped to its approver role.
request.note2: you request a decision; you cannot decide your own request.
request.subject: Decision record
request.subjectHint: The design decision to be approved, at its current version.
request.title: Title

readiness.title: Readiness for Transform
readiness.intro: What is missing before the Transform phase: decision rights and accountabilities.
readiness.fix: Go to the screen to fix it

check.charter_decision_rights: The charter names the decision rights
check.t11_seeded_decisions: The four playbook decisions are in the decision rights matrix
check.t11_approvers_mapped: Every approver role is mapped to a person or group
check.t12_accountable: Every RACI deliverable has exactly one accountable
